description: This file defines the DStDev class, implementing the DSTDEV statistical function for database calculations within PhpSpreadsheet. It provides methods to estimate the standard deviation of a population based on sample data filtered by specified criteria.

classes.name: DStDev
classes.description: Class implementing the DSTDEV database function to compute standard deviation based on filtered data.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of a filtered dataset based on the database, field, and criteria provided.
